messages.reasoning_content: Let me look at the workspace before answering.

function.name: Read
function.description: Read a file from the workspace. Returns content with line numbers, cat -n style.

file_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the file to read

offset.description: Line number to start reading from, 1-based

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

function.name: Write
function.description: Create a new file or overwrite an existing one. Overwriting a file requires having read it first in this session.

file_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to write

content.description: Full content to write to the file
